Great question! Getting your new mattress set up correctly will ensure you have the best experience from the very first night. Here’s a simple guide on what to do: 📦

1. Unbox and Unroll: Your mattress will arrive compressed in a box. Simply move it to your bedroom, take it out of the box, and carefully unroll it onto your bed frame or foundation.

2. Let it Breathe: Once unrolled, it will start to expand to its full size. It's a good idea to let it air out for a few hours. You might notice a slight “new product” scent, which is normal and will fade away.

3. The Break-In Period: Just like a new pair of shoes, your mattress has a break-in period. It might feel firmer at first than you expected. The best way to break it in is simply by sleeping on it every night. Over the first 30 days, the foam will soften slightly and adapt to your body.

Since you chose the flippable Plank Firm, you can start on either the Firm or Ultra-Firm side to see which you prefer!
